invariants.rationale: Padding values are typically non-negative, so their sum is also likely non-negative.
The method directly returns the sum of padLeft.get(this) and padRight.get(this).
result is the sum of padLeft and padRight, so it must be at least padLeft.get(this) if both paddings are non-negative.
Similarly, result must be at least padRight.get(this) assuming non-negative paddings.
Javadoc and method logic indicate result equals sum of getPadLeft and getPadRight.
